approved: Explicit user approval for persistent workers, three-node serial rollout and config-preserving Core handoff

execution.core: Native media handle allocation, authenticated routing, RAM image cache. No event search, JPEG retrieval, preview transport or frame decoding in the normal Core thumbnail path. Native recording-index browsing and other Tapo integration functions still run on Core.
execution.worker: Existing lease-selected camera owner fetches event JPEG or a bounded preview and decodes one frame. Pinned SDK and image; no new NATS subjects/users or ownership framework.
execution.media_handle: Core getUserID/playerID supplied transiently, worker never allocates a competing getUserID.

scopes.identity: HA user + tab nonce + monotonic sequence + scope nonce
scopes.range: Camera entry, date, optional exact parent clip bounds
scopes.navigation: Native media-browsed current event rewrites only thumbnail URLs; location-changed/popstate/pagehide revoke old tab scope
scopes.sharing: Same image job shared across tabs; navigation cancels only when its last valid consumer leaves
scopes.cleanup: Explicit signed worker cancel acknowledged after SDK task/session and original HTTP admission drain. Independent owner-generation lease watch at 250ms and 32-second worker job deadline.
scopes.node_limit: One fetch per worker node; camera lock shared with playback

resources.preload: SDK/Pillow imports before socket readiness, no camera login. About 47 seconds at cold worker startup on the approved CPU cap; workers stay warm afterwards.
resources.measurement_cgroup: Actual Podman container cgroup located from its init PID. Host launcher memory (~10 MiB) is separate and must not be reported as the whole worker.

final_core_counters.note: Global counters include the initial cold-preload rollout and frontend validation iterations, not a failure-free controlled batch.

live_checks.native_ui_images: Two JPEGs appeared in the native in-app parts folder after navigation, with HTTP 200 scope acknowledgements. Closing the test tab left zero thumbnail jobs.
live_checks.overview_reloaded: Existing user Overview restored after handoff; final accessibility state has no Connection lost banner.

live_fixes: Cold SDK import initially ran inside an active fetch and delayed cancellation. Moved module preload before readiness; final workers passed readiness on all three nodes.
Worker cancellation now waits for the old HTTP handler to release admission before acknowledging; short admission wait covers scheduling handover.
Native media-browsed is authoritative. Avoid URL-order guards: HA may deliver a result before updating browser history. Retain monotonic server scope rejection for out-of-order POSTs.
limits: The source request deadline includes queue time. A large folder requiring many expensive keyframes can still show placeholders; this does not promise an instant full-day thumbnail index.
An in-flight SDK control HTTP call finishes before cancellation acknowledgement; cancellation is not zero-latency. Media generators and FFmpeg children close on cancellation.
Cross-tab isolation/deduplication and late-scope rejection were tested offline; live browser checks used a separate native tab and node2/node3 workers.
The prior one-hour TTL and quota tests remain offline; no forced production cache fill or one-hour wait.
Native Core-only thumbnail capability probe remains a separate explicit diagnostic, outside the normal UI thumbnail path.

final_health.pending_policy: Preserved; no automatic config sync or overwrite.
